note: 18 Oct 2026 - 'The One Thing Millionaires Do, and You Don't!' (Rumble v6qh3hy). Weekly agent.

clips.caption:
Most people think a million in sales means they're a millionaire.

Kevin Trudeau says that's wrong. Bring in $1 million but spend $2 million getting it, and you lost a million, not made one.

A real millionaire has net worth: every bill paid, every car owned outright, zero credit card debt, and a million still sitting in the bank.

Kevin made his first million in the 1970s - worth about $10 million today - and didn't call it a win until every debt was gone.

Do you know your real net worth, or just what your business brings in?

#kevintrudeau #networth #millionairemindset #debtfree #wealthbuilding #financialfreedom

Nobody successful had a balanced life when they were starting out.

Kevin Trudeau admits it about himself: "I never saw my kids. I never saw my spouse. I worked seven days a week, ten, twelve hours a day."

He calls it a magnificent obsession - golf, work, repeat, nothing else. Just singleness of purpose.

It's not glamorous and it isn't forever. But almost everyone who built real wealth paid this price first.

Would you give up your weekends for five years for real financial freedom after?

#kevintrudeau #successmindset #obsession #milliondollarmindset #hustleculture #wealthbuilding

clips.end_words: focused in on what you're doing
clips.caption:
He had the boat, the house, the wife, the wine - and he got comfortable.

Kevin Trudeau offered him a stock deal worth getting fired up about. His answer: "I have to become mentally broke again to make this work."

So he locked his golf clubs in a closet for a year and gave his wife the key. The boat? One day a week. No more.

That's delayed gratification: giving up what you love for a season so you stay hungry enough to build something bigger.

What would you lock away for a year for real wealth on the other side?

#kevintrudeau #delayedgratification #millionairemindset #wealthbuilding #successhabits #financialfreedom

Thomas Edison was known to never really go to bed - an hour of sleep in his workshop, then back to work.

Kevin Trudeau says Einstein did the same. Steve Jobs and Elon Musk, asked how much they slept starting out, basically laughed at the question.

They weren't forcing themselves through exhaustion - they loved the work so much they got upset when their body made them stop.

That's the obsession behind almost every fortune ever built, not balance, just total absorption in the work.

Could you fall in love with your work the way Edison fell in love with his?

#kevintrudeau #thomasedison #obsession #millionairemindset #successhabits #wealthbuilding
